verdict.rationale: SAM.gov documents first-party bulk retrieval. The Entity Management API accepts up to 100 UEI values in one request, returns up to 1,000,000 records as JSON or CSV, and offers an API Extract for bulk retrieval, with the extract URL optionally emailed. The Opportunities API supports pagination. All of this is bulk read/export; nothing shows bulk actions or changes applied across many items. Missing for 10: bulk write/update/action operations across items, documented batch job management, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the extract workflow.
